verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says Guided Reviews break diffs into focused sections with explainers on what changed and why, which matches the story nearly word for word. Linear's own Diffs review experience provides the surface where this happens. The evidence is a single changelog line: it does not explicitly say the explainers are AI-generated or show how deep they go. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Guided Reviews generates sections and explanations, explicit confirmation that the explainers are AI-generated, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
